32600.meaning2: most noble of the biped; i.e. the Enlightened One

32601.meaning2: most noble of the biped; i.e. the Enlightened One

examples.text: dasavass'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu dasa kusalakammapathā sabbena sabbaṃ antaradhāyissanti, dasa akusalakammapathā atibyādippissanti
api dibbesu kāmesu, ratiṃ so n'ādhigacchati, taṇhakkhayarato hoti, sammāsambuddhasāvako.
ito tvaṃ kālaṅ'kato kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissasi, dibbehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricāressasī'ti.

32607.meaning1: heavenly pleasure; divine sensual pleasure; pleasure of the gods

examples.text: mānusakehi, bho gotama, kāmehi dibbakāmā abhikkantatarā ca paṇītatarā cā'ti.
kusaggen'udakam'ādāya, samudde udakaṃ mine, evaṃ mānusakā kāmā, dibbakāmāna santike.
tīṇi cakkhūni, maṃsacakkhu, dibbacakkhu, paññācakkhu.
pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmi, dibbacakkhuṃ visodhitaṃ, tevijjo iddhipatto'mhi, cetopariyāyakovido'ti.

32611.commentary: (ANa) dibbacakkhukānaṃ yadidaṃ anuruddho'ti dibbacakkhukabhikkhūnaṃ anuruddhatthero aggo'ti vadati. tassa ciṇṇavasitāya aggabhāvo veditabbo. thero kira bhojanapapañcamattaṃ ṭhapetvā sesakālaṃ ālokaṃ vaḍḍhetvā dibbacakkhunā satte olokento'va viharati. iti ahorattaṃ ciṇṇavasitāya esa dibbacakkhukānaṃ aggo nāma jāto. apica kappasatasahassaṃ patthitabhāvenapesa dibbacakkhukānaṃ aggo'va jāto. (NIDD1a) dibbacakkhukā'ti dibbasadisañāṇacakkhukā. atha vā dibbavihārasannissayena laddhañāṇacakkhukā.

examples.text: mahantasmiṃ kho pana lokasannivāse santi samaṇabrāhmaṇā iddhimanto dibbacakkhukā paracittaviduno. te dūrato'pi passanti, āsannā'pi na dissanti, cetasā'pi cittaṃ pajānanti.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dibbacakkhukānaṃ yadidaṃ anuruddho.

32612.meaning1: knowledge of clairvoyance; understanding of supernormal vision
32612.commentary: (PMa) dibbacakkhuñāṇan'ti dibbasadisattā dibbaṃ. devānañ'hi sucaritakammanibbattaṃ pitta-semha-ruhir'ādīhi apalibuddhaṃ upakkilesavimuttatāya dūre'pi ārammaṇa-sampaṭicchana-samatthaṃ dibbaṃ pasādacakkhu hoti.

examples.text: obhāsavasena nānatt'ekatta-rūpanimittānaṃ dassan'aṭṭhe paññā dibbacakkhuñāṇaṃ.

32614.synonym: ābhāti, kāsati, tapati, pakāseti, pabhāsayati, bhāsati, sobhati

examples.text: evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ manussattaṃ labhati. evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho. evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo loke dibbati.

tassa yapaccayassa cavagga yakāra vakārattaṃ hoti dhātūnaṃ antena saha yathāsambhavaṃ. vuccate, vuccante, uccate, uccante, paccate, paccante. majjate, majjante, yujjate, yujjante. bujjhate, bujjhante, kujjhate, kujjhante, ujjhate, ujjhante. haññate, haññante. kayyate, kayyante. dibbate, dibbante.
yadā, bhante, kevalakappā ca devā tāvatiṃsā sudhammāyaṃ sabhāyaṃ sannisinnā honti sannipatitā, mahatī ca dibbaparisā samantato nisinnā honti, cattāro ca mahārājāno catuddisā nisinnā honti.
acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata, bho, samaṇassa mah'iddhikatā mah'ānubhāvatā, yatra hi nāma dibbabhavanaṃ pād'aṅguṭṭhakena saṅkampessati sampakampessati sampavedhessatī'ti!

32618.meaning1: attachment to heavenly existence; heavenly bond; (comm) five higher fetters

examples.text: ke ca te ataruṃ paṅkaṃ, maccudheyyaṃ suduttaraṃ, ke hitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ, dibbayogaṃ upaccagun'ti.
pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmi, dibbacakkhu visodhitaṃ, iddhimā paracittaññū, dibbasotañ'ca pāpuṇiṃ.

32622.meaning1: knowledge of supernormal hearing; knowledge of clairaudience
32622.meaning2: knowledge of supernormal hearing; knowledge of clairaudience

examples.text: ettāvatā vipassanāñāṇaṃ, manomayañāṇaṃ, iddhividhañāṇaṃ, dibbasotañāṇaṃ, cetopariyañāṇaṃ, pubbenivāsañāṇaṃ, dibbacakkhuvasena nipphannaṃ anāgat'aṃsañāṇa-yathākamm'ūpagañāṇa-dvayaṃ, dibbacakkhuñāṇaṃ, āsavakkhayañāṇan'ti dasa ñāṇāni niddiṭṭhāni honti.

puna caparaṃ, ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa itthiratanaṃ pāturahosi abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā n'ātidīghā n'ātirassā n'ātikisā n'ātithūlā n'ātikāḷikā n'āccodātā atikkantā mānusivaṇṇaṃ appattā dibbavaṇṇaṃ.
dutiyam'pi kho te akkhadhuttā akkhehi dibbiṃsu. dutiyam'pi kho so akkhadhutto āgat'āgataṃ kaliṃ gilati.

32631.meaning1: with divine authority; with heavenly power; with celestial influence

examples.text: iti kira tumhe, bhikkhave, dibbena āyunā aṭṭīyatha harāyatha jigucchatha, dibbena vaṇṇena dibbena sukhena dibbena yasena dibben'ādhipateyyena aṭṭīyatha harāyatha jigucchatha, pag'eva kho pana, bhikkhave, tumhehi kāyaduccaritena aṭṭīyitabbaṃ harāyitabbaṃ jigucchitabbaṃ, vacīduccaritena… manoduccaritena aṭṭīyitabbaṃ harāyitabbaṃ jigucchitabban'ti.
tatth'āyaṃ samayo diyaḍḍho māso seso gimhānan'ti vassānassa paṭhamo māso icc'ete aḍḍhateyyamāsā uṇhasamayo, pariḷāhasamayo, gilānasamayo, kammasamayo, addhānagamanasamayo, vātavuṭṭhisamayo
sādhikam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, diyaḍḍhasikkhāpadasataṃ anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati yattha attakāmā kulaputtā sikkhanti.

32633.commentary: (PMa) buddhadhammavāre diyaḍḍhasatan'ti chakkhattuṃ pañcavīsati satañ'ca paññāsañ'ca honti, taddiguṇā niruttiyo taddiguṇāni ñāṇāni.

examples.text: paññāsaṃ ca diyaḍḍhasataṃ, dve ca veyyākaraṇaṃ apare ca, tevanāmagataṃ ca anupubbaṃ, ekamanā nisāmetha mud'aggaṃ.
chasu buddhadhammesu diyaḍḍhasataṃ dhammā, diyaḍḍhasataṃ atthā, tīṇi niruttisatāni, cha ñāṇasatāni.

32635.meaning1: one hundred and fifty training rules

examples.text: sādhikam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, diyaḍḍhasikkhāpadasataṃ anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati yattha attakāmā kulaputtā sikkhanti.

32636.meaning1: is given; is offered; is donated
32636.meaning2: is given; is offered; is donated

examples.text: yāni kho pana tāni, brāhmaṇa, niccadānāni anukulayaññāni sīlavante pabbajite uddissa diyyanti, ayaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, yañño imāya tividhāya yaññasampadāya soḷasaparikkhārāya app'aṭṭhataro ca appasamārambhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mah'ānisaṃsataro cā'ti.
navachannake dāni diyyati, puṇṇ'āyaṃ doṇi suvāminī ṭhitā, bahuke jane pāsapāṇike, no ca kho me paṭibhāti bhuñjituṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannena uttaridirattatirattaṃ sahaseyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

32639.meaning1: two or three nights; two or three days

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannena uttaridirattatirattaṃ sahaseyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
siyā ca tassa bhikkhuno koci'd'eva paccayo senaṃ gamanāya, dirattatirattaṃ tena bhikkhunā senāya vasitabbaṃ. tato ce uttari vaseyya, pācittiyaṃ.

32640.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of dirattatiratta
32640.meaning1: for two or three nights; for two or three days

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannena uttaridirattatirattaṃ sahaseyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
siyā ca tassa bhikkhuno koci'd'eva paccayo senaṃ gamanāya, dirattatirattaṃ tena bhikkhunā senāya vasitabbaṃ. tato ce uttari vaseyya, pācittiyaṃ.

32641.synonym: amitta, ari, diṭṭha, paccatthika, paccāmitta, paṭisattu, paṭisūra, veripuggala, verī, sapatta
32641.commentary: (DHPa) diso disan'ti coro coraṃ. disvā'ti pāṭhaseso. (UDa) diso disan'ti dūsako dūsanīyaṃ coro coraṃ, disvā'ti vacanaseso.

examples.text: diso disaṃ yaṃ taṃ kayirā, verī vā pana verinaṃ, micchāpaṇihitaṃ cittaṃ, pāpiyo naṃ tato kare.
cakkhuṃ sarīraṃ upahanti tena, nihīyati vaṇṇabalaṃ matī ca, ānandino tassa disā bhavanti, hit'esino n'āssa sukhī bhavanti.
471, 483. disassa passa dissa dakkhā vā.

32643.synonym: upanibha, nibha, paṭibhāga, sadisa, sadisopama, sannibha, sappaṭibhāga, sarikkhaka

examples.text: carañ'ce n'ādhigaccheyya, seyyaṃ sadisam'attano, ekacariyaṃ daḷhaṃ kayirā, n'atthi bāle sahāyatā.
na te idaṃ citta yathā purāṇakaṃ, n'āhaṃ alaṃ tuyha vase nivattituṃ, mah'esino pabbajito'mhi sāsane, na mādisā honti vināsadhārino.

32644.meaning2: who has gone elsewhere, to another place

32645.meaning2: intending to go elsewhere, to go to another place

32647.commentary: (SNa) taṃ me, sakka, varaṃ disā'ti, sakka devaseṭṭha, taṃ me varaṃ uttamaṃ ṭhānaṃ okāsaṃ disaṃ ācikkha kathehī'ti vadati.

examples.text: bhavam'atthu bhavantaṃ jotipālaṃ, rājā disampati bhavantaṃ jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ āmantayati, rājā disampati bhoto jotipālassa māṇavassa dassanakāmo'ti
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikāni apagatasambandhāni disā vidisā vikkhittāni
disā catasso vidisā catasso, uddhaṃ adho dasa disā imāyo, na tuyhaṃ adiṭṭhaṃ asutaṃ amutaṃ, atho aviññātaṃ kiñcanam'atthi loke, ācikkha dhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, jātijarāya idha vippahānaṃ.
na pupphagandho paṭivātam'eti, na candanaṃ tagaramallikā, satañ'ca gandho paṭivātam'eti, sabbā disā sappuriso pavāyati.
so mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ.

32651.commentary: (NIDD1) gacchato agataṃ disan'ti. agatā disā vuccati amataṃ nibbānaṃ. yo so sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ. agatapubbā sā disā na sā disā gatapubbā iminā dīghena addhunā.

examples.text: katī parissayā loke, gacchato agataṃ disaṃ, ye bhikkhu abhisambhave, pantamhi sayan'āsane.
tassā evam'assa, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ agatapubbañ'c'eva disaṃ gaccheyyaṃ, akhāditapubbāni ca tiṇāni khādeyyaṃ, apītapubbāni ca pānīyāni piveyyan'ti.
ujuko nāma so maggo, abhayā nāma sā disā, ratho akūjano nāma, dhammacakkehi saṃyuto.
agārino annada-pānavatthadā, avhāyikā tam'pi disaṃ vadanti, esā disā paramā setaketu, yaṃ patvā dukkhī sukhino bhavanti.

32653.meaning1: crow kept on a ship to search for land
32653.meaning2: crow kept on board a ship in order to search land
32653.commentary: (VISMa) disājānanako kāko disākāko, lakkhaṇamattañ'c'etaṃ yo koci tādiso sakunto veditabbo.

examples.text: tīradassiṃ sakuṇan'ti disākākaṃ.

32655.meaning1: red glow in the sky; unusual redness of the horizon
32655.meaning2: glow or burning in the sky

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… ukkāpāto bhavissati, disāḍāho bhavissati, bhūmicālo bhavissati, devadudrabhi bhavissati, candimasūriyanakkhattānaṃ uggamanaṃ ogamanaṃ saṃkilesaṃ vodānaṃ bhavissati

32656.meaning1: red glow in the sky; unusual redness of the horizon
32656.commentary: (DNt) aggisikhadhūmasikh'ādīnaṃ bahudhā pātubhāvo eva disādāho nāmā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… bhūmikampaṃ disādāhaṃ bhumm'antalikkhaṃ jotisaṃ lok'āyatikaṃ sācakkaṃ migacakkaṃ antaracakkaṃ missak'uppādaṃ sakuṇarutaravitaṃ sikkhā karaṇīyā
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, yasmiṃ puggale puggalo abhippasanno hoti, so disāpakkanto hoti… so vibbhanto hoti… so kālaṅ'kato hoti. tassa evaṃ hoti, yo kho my'āyaṃ puggalo piyo manāpo so kālaṅ'kato'ti.
tena kho pana samayena rājagahakassa seṭṭhissa sattavassiko sīs'ābādho hoti. bahū mahantā mahantā disāpāmokkhā vejjā āgantvā n'āsakkhiṃsu arogaṃ kātuṃ.
mahāsatto hi tadā mahati uḷārabhoge kule nibbattitvā vuddhim'anvāya disāpāmokkhassa ācariyassa santike garuvāsaṃ vasanto sabbasippānaṃ nipphattiṃ patvā kulagharaṃ āgantvā

32660.meaning1: looking around at the cardinal points

examples.text: tena hi, samaṇa, disāmukho bhuñjasī'ti? na khv'āhaṃ, bhagini, disāmukho bhuñjāmī'ti.

32662.meaning2: living in another country or in different parts of country

32663.meaning2: living in another country or in different parts of country

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikāni apagatasambandhāni disāvidisāvikkhittāni aññena hatth'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena pād'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena gopphak'aṭṭhikaṃ

na hi, bhante, acalaṃ hoti santasantan'ti. taṃ y'eva pana, mahārāja, udakaṃ bhājanagataṃ aggiṃ ujjāletvā uddhane ṭhapitaṃ hoti, api nu tattha udakaṃ acalaṃ hoti santasantan'ti? na hi, bhante, calati khubbhati luḷati āvilati ūmijātaṃ hoti, uddham'adho disāvidisaṃ gacchati, uttarati patarati pheṇamālī hotī'ti.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikāni apagatasambandhāni disāvidisāvikkhittāni aññena hatth'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena pād'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena gopphak'aṭṭhikaṃ

32666.meaning1: illuminating the directions; lighting up the quarters; radiant all around
32666.commentary: (ANa) disāvirocanā'ti sabbadisāsu virocamānā. atha vā pabhāsantī'ti disāhi disā obhāsanti. virocanā'ti virocamānā.

examples.text: cando ca sūriyo ca ubho sudassanā, obhāsayaṃ anupariyanti yāvatā, tamonudā te pana antalikkhagā, nabhe pabhāsanti disāvirocanā.

32667.meaning1: here and there; hither and thither
32667.meaning2: hither and thither; in various locations
32667.commentary: (DNa) anuyanti disodisan'ti tāya tāya disāya caranti. (PVa) pakkamanti disodisan'ti disato disaṃ anekayojanantarikaṃ ṭhānaṃ pakkamanti.

examples.text: ime sudaṃ yanti disodisaṃ pure, bhay'aṭṭitā leṇagavesino puthu, te dāni saṅgamma vasanti ekato, yatthaṭṭhitā duppasah'ajja'me mayā.
sātunnavasanā eke, aññe kesanivāsanā, petā bhattāya gacchanti, pakkamanti disodisaṃ.

32668.meaning1: is seen; is observed; is manifest

examples.text: mahantasmiṃ kho pana lokasannivāse santi samaṇabrāhmaṇā iddhimanto dibbacakkhukā paracittaviduno. te dūrato'pi passanti, āsannā'pi na dissanti, cetasā'pi cittaṃ pajānanti.
dissati, bhikkhave, imassa cātumahābhūtikassa kāyassa ācayo'pi apacayo'pi ādānam'pi nikkhepanam'pi
mohasambandhano loko, bhabbarūpo'va dissati, upadhibandhano bālo, tamasā parivārito, sassato'riva khāyati, passato n'atthi kiñcanan'ti.
sadevakassa lokassa, yathā dissati cakkhumā, sabbaṃ tamaṃ vinodetvā, eko'va ratim'ajjhagā.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, palagaṇḍassa vā palagaṇḍ'antevāsissa vā vāsijaṭe dissant'eva aṅgulipadāni dissati aṅguṭṭhapadaṃ.

32671.notes: Kaccāyana considers as active not passive

examples.text: disa'icc'etassa dhātussa passa dissa dakkha'icc'ete ādesā honti vā. passati, dissati, dakkhati, adakkha. vā'ti kim'atthaṃ? addasa.

evaṃ, bhante'ti kho, bhikkhave, abhibhū bhikkhu sikhissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paṭissutvā dissamānena'pi kāyena dhammaṃ desesi, adissamānena'pi kāyena dhammaṃ desesi, dissamānenapi heṭṭhimena upaḍḍhakāyena adissamānena uparimena upaḍḍhakāyena dhammaṃ desesi, dissamānenapi uparimena upaḍḍhakāyena adissamānena heṭṭhimena upaḍḍhakāyena dhammaṃ desesi.

32674.meaning1: having seen; having understood; having found out
32674.meaning2: having seen, having found, having understood

examples.text: ete vivādā samaṇesu jātā, etesu ugghāti nighāti hoti, etam'pi disvā virame kath'ojjaṃ, na h'añña'd'atth'atthi pasaṃsalābhā.
kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, saṃvaro hoti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe n'ādhimuccati, appiyarūpe rūpe na byāpajjati, upaṭṭhitakāyassati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso
disvāna rūpesu vihaññamāne, ruppanti rūpesu janā pamattā, tasmā tuvaṃ piṅgiya appamatto, jahassu rūpaṃ apunabbhavāya.
addasā kho, bhikkhave, kummo kacchapo siṅgālaṃ dūrato'va gocarapasutaṃ. disvāna soṇḍipañcamāni aṅgāni sake kapāle samodahitvā app'ossukko tuṇhībhūto saṅkasāyati.

32676.meaning1: as soon as having seen; only having seen

examples.text: atha kho te kosalakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā māgadhakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā tatth'eva ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu, disvā'va mayaṃ taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ gamissāmā'ti.
nagā samuddā saritā vasun'dharā, disā catasso vidisā adho divā, sabbe aniccā tibhavā upaddutā, kuhiṃ gato citta sukhaṃ ramissasi.
andhatamaṃ tadā hoti andhakāratimisā. n'eva tāva rattin'divā paññāyanti, na mās'addhamāsā paññāyanti, na utusaṃvaccharā paññāyanti.
taṃ katvā ito cuto divam'upapajji, sukataphalavipākam'anubhosi, caviya punaridh'āgato samāno, dvidugamavaratarahanuttam'alattha.

evaṃ vutte purimāni, bhante, divasāni purimatarāni, nānātitthiyānaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ kotūhalasālāya sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ abhisaññānirodhe kathā udapādi, kathaṃ nu kho, bho, abhisaññānirodho hotī'ti?
so tāya dhammapariyattiyā divasaṃ atināmeti, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, n'ānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhu, bhikkhu pariyattibahulo, no dhammavihārī.
yato uggacchati sūriyo, ādicco maṇḍalī mahā, yassa c'uggacchamānassa, saṃvarī'pi nirujjhati, yassa c'uggate sūriye, divaso'ti pavuccati.
rañño kira vappamaṅgaladivaso nāma hoti, tadā anekappakāraṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādenti.

32683.grammar: ind, adv, masc abl sg of divasa

examples.text: mahāmāyā'pi devī pure puṇṇamāya sattamadivasato paṭṭhāya vigatasurāpānaṃ mālāgandhavibhūtisampannaṃ nakkhattakīḷaṃ anubhavamānā sattame divase pāto'va uṭṭhāya

32684.meaning1: part of the day; portion of time

examples.text: tesaṃ kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ? upacārasamādhi kusalavīthiyaṃ javitvā bhav'aṅgaṃ otarati, appanāsamādhi divasabhāge appetvā nisinnassa divasabhāgam'pi kusalavīthiyaṃ javati, na bhav'aṅgaṃ otarati. imesu dvīsu samādhīsu nimittapātubhāvena upacārasamādhinā samāhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.

32686.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of divasabhāga
32686.commentary: (MNa) rattibhāgaṃ vā divasabhāgaṃ vā'ti rattikoṭṭhāse vā divasakoṭṭhāse vā… divasabhāge ñatvā divā'va pakkamitabbaṃ, divā paribandhe sati sūriy'atthaṅ'gamanaṃ āgametabbaṃ.

examples.text: tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā rattibhāgaṃ vā divasabhāgaṃ vā tamhā vanapatthā pakkamitabbaṃ, na vatthabbaṃ.

32687.meaning1: heated during the day; left in the sun for the day

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma phālo divasasantatto udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati sandhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati. evam'eva so pāyaso udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati sandhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati.

32689.grammar: ind, adv, masc acc sg of divasa
32689.meaning1: by day; during the day; for a day

examples.text: divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhessāma
seyyathā'pi nāma phālo divasaṃ santatto udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati sandhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati. evam'eva so pāyaso udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati sandhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati.

32690.meaning1: heated during the day; heated for the day

examples.text: divasaṃsantatte ayokaṭāhe dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni nipāteyya

32691.meaning1: remainder of the day; what's left of the day

examples.text: pana, samma kārāyana, nagarakamhā medāḷupaṃ nāma sakyānaṃ nigamo hotī'ti? na dūre, mahārāja, tīṇi yojanāni, sakkā divas'āvasesena gantun'ti.
te divase divase kappasatasahassaṃ kappasatasahassaṃ anussareyyuṃ

32693.grammar: ind, adv, gen sg of diva

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo sabbasetena vaḷavābhirathena sāvatthiyā niyyāti divādivassa.

32694.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of diva

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, vadhukā yaññad'eva rattiṃ vā divaṃ vā ānītā hoti, tāva'd'ev'assā tibbaṃ hir'ottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti sassuyā'pi sasure'pi sāmike'pi antamaso dāsakammakaraporisesu.

32695.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of diva

examples.text: yam'pi no saddhā gahapatikā divā vikāle paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā denti, tatra'p'ime mukh'āvaraṇaṃ maññe karontī'ti.
papañ'ca udapānañ'ca, ye dadanti upassayaṃ, tesaṃ divā ca ratto ca, sadā puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati.

32696.meaning1: by day and night; all day and night

examples.text: suppabuddhaṃ pabujjhanti, sadā gotamasāvakā, yesaṃ divā ca ratto ca, niccaṃ buddhagatā sati.
papañ'ca udapānañ'ca, ye dadanti upassayaṃ, tesaṃ divā ca ratto ca, sadā puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati.

32697.meaning1: taking a siesta; having a nap

examples.text: abhijānāsi no tvaṃ, rājañña, divā seyyaṃ upagato supinakaṃ passitā ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakan'ti

32698.synonym: ādicca, pabhaṅkara, bhāṇumant, ravi, verocana, sataraṃsī, suriya, sūriya, harissa

examples.text: kiṃ ummatto'si, nanu idān'eva divākaro atthaṅ'gato, so kathaṃ imaṃ puṇṇacandaṃ anubandhamāno uggacchissati?
divāṭṭhāne nisinnakāle pana okāsaṃ kāretvā'va pucchantassa kathetabbo, akāretvā pucchantassa na kathetabbo. idaṃ vattaṃ ajānitvā pucchanto paṭipadāya na saṇṭhāti nāma.

sappi'ādīni bhesajjāni aṭṭhavidhāni pānakāni vatthacchādanamālāgandh'ādīni vā ādāya vihāraṃ gantvā tāni datvā divāṭṭhānaṃ pavisitvā okāsaṃ kāretvā pañhaṃ pucchati. evañ'hi vattaṃ ñatvā pucchanto paṭipadāya saṇṭhāti nāma.
